supersedes.reason: That card proposed a brand-new queue_request.py module and a brand-new mcp_queue_requests_b282_v1.jsonl log. Direct inspection of launch_queue_contract.py + launch_queue_persist.py (B119) shows equivalent dataclasses/persistence already exist and are already wired into server.py as 3 read-only tools. The corrected card below (CLAUDE_TASK_MCP_QUEUE_REQUEST_TOOL_EXTEND_B286_V1) extends the existing modules additively instead of duplicating them. Renumbered to B286 to avoid a batch-token collision with this planning task's own B282 id.

next_wave_cards.objective: Additively extend launch_queue_contract.py (LaunchRequest: +model, +owner_prompt, +requested_at, +stale_timeout_seconds; +deterministic_request_id helper) and launch_queue_persist.py (+find_open_requests, extended _PROCESS_LOG_KEYS), then register ONE new write-gated MCP tool geoai_task_queue_request in server.py per task_mcp_mvp_patch_plan_b282_v1.json's api_surface_new_tool schema. Reuses the existing append-only log at tools/geoai-task-mcp/logs/launch_queue_audit.jsonl -- no new log file. No process launch; LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED stays False.
acceptance: LaunchRequest gains exactly 4 new optional fields with safe defaults; no existing field renamed/removed/reordered in a way that breaks as_dict() callers
deterministic_request_id(task_id, runner, requested_at) matches B281 section_1: sha1(f'{task_id}:{runner}:{requested_at}').hexdigest()[:16]
New tool geoai_task_queue_request registered additively in server.py; existing 24 tools unchanged (list_tools count check: 24 -> 25)
Write-gate-off (default): persisted_entry is null, zero bytes appended to the log
Write-gate-on: exactly one JSONL line appended per non-duplicate, non-idempotent request
Idempotency: same request_id submitted twice while the first is non-terminal returns idempotent_noop=true and appends nothing
Duplicate-runner block: a second runner submitting for the same task_id while an open entry exists for a different runner returns duplicate_runner_blocked=true and appends nothing
LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED remains False in every code path; no subprocess/os.exec/os.spawn/os.system/os.popen import added anywhere in the diff
Shell test validates schema, write-gate-off/on, idempotency, and duplicate-runner behavior

notes.why_renumbered: This planning task owns batch token B282; the B281-proposed queue-tool implementation card also claimed B282, which would collide with this task's own task_id batch token under taskctl's runner/task batch guard. Renumbering the corrected card to B286 (and its dependents to B287-B289) avoids that collision while preserving the original dependency order (queue tool first, then stale-recovery + cost-ledger in parallel, then Codex loop wiring last).
